stories.story_fr: Americas Materials Solutions a vu son CA bondir de 21% au T1 2026 et son EBITDA ajuste de 75%, porte par des volumes de granulats en hausse de 14% et de ciment de 10%.
stories.story_en: Americas Materials Solutions saw revenue jump 21% in Q1 2026 and Adjusted EBITDA up 75%, driven by aggregates volumes up 14% and cement volumes up 10%.
stories.quote: Aggregates volumes increased by 14% year-over-year, while pricing declined by 1% ... Cement volumes were 10% ahead of the prior year

stories.story_fr: CRH a annonce l'acquisition d'Axius Water (0,7 Md$) pour renforcer sa position de leader des solutions d'infrastructure de l'eau aux Etats-Unis, dans une serie de neuf acquisitions pour 0,9 Md$ au T1 2026.
stories.story_en: CRH announced the acquisition of Axius Water ($0.7B) to strengthen its leadership in US water infrastructure solutions, part of nine acquisitions worth $0.9B in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: agreement to acquire Axius Water, a leading provider of specialized water quality solutions in North America, for a consideration of $0.7 billion

stories.story_fr: CRH a signe 1,9 Md$ de cessions strategiques sur trois activites non coeur (accessoires de construction, jardin, MoistureShield), reallouant le capital vers des plateformes a forte croissance.
stories.story_en: CRH agreed $1.9B of strategic divestitures across three non-core businesses (construction accessories, lawn and garden, MoistureShield), reallocating capital toward higher-growth platforms.
stories.quote: $1.9bn of strategic divestitures agreed across three non-core businesses

stories.story_fr: International Solutions a vu son EBITDA ajuste progresser de 32% au T1 2026 grace aux efficacites operationnelles et a l'optimisation du portefeuille, malgre des volumes affectes par la meteo.
stories.story_en: International Solutions grew Adjusted EBITDA 32% in Q1 2026 thanks to operational efficiencies and portfolio optimization, despite weather-impacted volumes.
stories.quote: Adjusted EBITDA was 32% ahead of the prior year, driven by operational efficiencies and portfolio optimization

stories.story_fr: CRH a ete integre a l'indice S&P 500 en 2025, signe de reconnaissance de son echelle et de son leadership de marche, avec une performance record (resultat net FY25 +8%, EBITDA ajuste +11%).
stories.story_en: CRH was added to the S&P 500 index in 2025, a recognition of its scale and market leadership, alongside record performance (FY25 net income +8%, Adjusted EBITDA +11%).
stories.signal: Reconnaissance de l'echelle et du leadership
stories.quote: Inclusion in the S&P 500 Index, a powerful recognition of our Unmatched Scale and Market Leadership
